text: ハーバーシティは34分、ジョン・ウィットフィールドのスルーパスでマレク・バロスがゴールチャンスを作りました。バロスのシュートは約5.7メートルから放たれましたが、相手にブロックされてしまいました[#670] [#672]。短いパスでの落ち着いた攻めからの見事な連携でしたが、得点はまだ0-0のままです。

trace.output: Brief: Big chance missed - Marek Barros for fan audience in ja

- Marek Barros missed a big chance with a shot that was blocked, having an xG of 0.495 from 5.7 meters [#672]
- The assist came from Joon Whitfield via a through pass, contributing to the build-up of the opportunity [#670]
- The chance resulted from a 7.4-second patient build-up involving 2 completed passes by Harbour City [#669, #670]
- Score remained 0-0 after the missed big chance by Harbour City at 34 minutes

- Harbour City’s 4-2-3-1 formation and patient short passing style are evident in the build-up to the chance, with only two passes over 7.4 seconds involving Marek Barros and Joon Whitfield, indicating controlled progression from deep midfield zones (start_x_own: 77.7) rather than direct play [#669, #670].
- The key chance came from a through ball assist by Whitfield to Barros, reflecting a tactical attempt to exploit spaces between Seabrook Town’s 3-4-3 defensive lines, leveraging a central attacking midfielder’s run behind the opposition’s midfield block [#670].
- Seabrook Town’s 3-4-3 wide, crossing approach likely drew their defensive shape towards the flanks, allowing Harbour City space to operate centrally and create a near 0.5 xG opportunity from open play, although the shot was ultimately blocked [#670, #672].
- The moment shows Harbour City’s emphasis on patient, possession-based buildup to create high-value chances, contrasting with Seabrook Town’s focus on width and crossing; Seabrook’s higher PPDA (9.7) suggests less intense pressing, enabling Harbour City’s calm buildup [team_styles, last_10_minutes].
